scenarios.name: Pedestrian hesitation
scenarios.line: A pedestrian hesitates at the crosswalk ahead, close to the camera car's path.

scenarios.name: Children in a school zone
scenarios.line: A child or children unexpectedly move into the road close in front of the camera car.

scenarios.name: Delivery
scenarios.line: A delivery van is stopped in the road ahead, with a courier on foot beside it near the camera car's lane.

scenarios.name: Construction zone
scenarios.line: Construction workers in hard hats and hi-vis vests are on foot in the roadwork right next to the camera car's lane.

scenarios.name: Sanitation
scenarios.line: A garbage truck is stopped in the camera car's lane ahead, with a sanitation worker on foot beside it.

scenarios.name: Night
scenarios.line: At night, one or more pedestrians are in or step into the road ahead of the camera car.

V1.control: The pedestrian stands on the line to the left of the camera car's lane and leans toward the lane, keeping both feet on the line.

V2.control: The pedestrian steps off the line to the left of the camera car's lane and stands one step inside the lane.

V1.control: The pedestrian stops on the centre line and stays there without stepping into the camera car's lane.

V2.control: The pedestrian on the centre line briefly steps into the camera car's lane, then steps back.

V1.control: The pedestrian waves the camera car on and stays on the curb.

V2.control: The pedestrian holds up a hand toward the camera car, then walks onto the crosswalk.

V1.control: The pedestrian steps out early, while the camera car is still far away, and crosses with a short pause in the middle.

V2.control: The pedestrian steps out late, when the camera car is close, and stops suddenly at the edge of its lane.

V1.control: The child runs out from behind a line of stopped cars.

V2.control: The child runs out from behind a parked school bus.

V1.control: The child runs across the road on the crosswalk.

V2.control: The child runs across the road where there is no crosswalk.

V1.control: The children cross in a single line, one behind another.

V2.control: The children cross as a scattered group, not in a line.

V1.control: A single child sits down on the road and stays there.

V2.control: Several children run around and play on the crosswalk.

V1.control: The camera car itself approaches the crossing children much faster than normal.

V2.control: Another car ahead of the camera car drives fast toward the crossing children and brakes hard just short of them.
The courier walks from the front of the van across the camera car's lane toward the houses on the right, without looking at traffic.
The courier stands beside the van on the traffic side, right at the edge of the camera car's lane.
A worker walks out of the closed-off lane into the camera car's lane.
A worker walks around the back left corner of the truck into the oncoming lane.
One of two workers walks from the back of the truck across the road toward the bins at the left curb, while the other stays at the truck.
The worker rolls a bin away from the back of the truck to the right curb.
The worker carries a trash can from the left curb across the oncoming lane toward the truck.

V1.control: The pedestrian wears a black coat and dark trousers.

V2.control: The pedestrian wears a white jacket with a yellow reflective vest over it, and light grey trousers.

V1.control: A group of four pedestrians walks close together across the road from the right sidewalk to the left.

V2.control: A group of four pedestrians walks together along the right edge of the camera car's lane, toward the camera car, without crossing.

V1.control: The pedestrian walks out from in front of a van stopped in the lane to the left, into the camera car's lane.

V2.control: The pedestrian stands still at the front right corner of a van stopped in the lane to the left, partly hidden, and does not step into the camera car's lane.

V1.control: An older woman slowly pushes a baby stroller from the right sidewalk out into the camera car's lane.

V2.control: An older woman slowly pushes a baby stroller along the right edge of the camera car's lane, facing away from it.
